counting_rule: Unit = one printed page: a full PDF page (2023) or one half of a two-page spread (2024, 2025). A unit counts as a content page when it has no extraction error, has >= 200 characters after normalization, and is not a cover, table of contents, credits/rights page or back cover.
redistribution: CC BY-NC-ND: raw PDFs are not committed (starter/data/raw is git-ignored); download them from source_path_or_url and keep the file names in local_path.
